column1: # Black/Matrix AD - English script: Seven Great Evil Gods lore
# No manual wrapping: patchline.py supplies pixel-aware line breaks.

column2: Yet once,
there were Seven $$大邪神$$s, boasting powers far greater than those white-$$羽$$ demons...
Namely...
$$ミカエル$$, $$大邪神$$ of Earth!
$$ガブリエル$$, $$大邪神$$ of Life!
$$ラファエル$$, $$大邪神$$ of the Sun!
$$ウリエル$$, $$大邪神$$ of Flame!
$$サリエル$$, $$大邪神$$ of Water!
$$ラグエル$$, $$大邪神$$ of Air!
And the one most feared among them...
$$メタトロン$$, $$大邪神$$ of Hell!!
The legendary $$大邪神$$ armor worn by $$メタトロン$$, the $$大邪神$$, in the $$創世記戦争$$...
was hidden in a temple I once ruled—
the $$太陽の神殿$$, where it was $$封印$$ed away!
When I found the $$大邪神$$ armor, I was overcome with joy.
It was the armor of $$メタトロン$$, the $$大邪神$$ of Hell!!
Its mighty magic power far exceeds the cheap $$悪魔の鎧$$ of the $$邪道騎士$$...
Why I was put in prison...
was because I began researching that forbidden $$大邪神$$ armor!!
So, old man, you were drawn to that armor,
and lost yourself in it!
The basis of $$この世$$ is $$弱肉強食$$!
Even if it is a $$血$$-soaked $$大邪神$$ armor,
don't you think it would be a waste not to use something so powerful...?!
After that, I continued researching it with $$ルピルピ$$,
managed to break the $$封印$$, and tried to wear the $$大邪神$$ armor, but...
I simply could not wear it. I failed at the final step and they caught me!
Why... did it fail?!
You'll understand when you see the actual $$大邪神$$ armor.
So... the $$大邪神$$ armor has already...
$$ユダ$$ stole it, you say?!
What in the world is that man after?!
I don't really get it, but for us to have $$自由$$, we can't avoid this, right!
Anyway, the $$大邪神$$ armor!
If we obtain it, its tremendous power will awaken.
Huh? What about saving his $$ご主人様$$?
O-oh, right. We mustn't forget that either.
Hmph. This sounds awfully fishy.
My name is $$ルピルピ$$!!
My hobby is keeping a $$日記$$!
That wording got me a tiiiny bit mad,
so I'll put you in my $$日記$$ too!!
S-still, I was outmatched by a little girl like this?!
Go to the $$封印の間$$!
Return to town for now!!
